A modified '''DUM-series pit droid''' worked at the bar at [[Tanda's Cantina]] aboard a [[Suria space station|space station]] above the [[planet]] [[Suria]]. Sometime around [[18 BBY]], the [[DUM-series pit droid|droid]] interacted with the rogue [[Clone Force 99]] members [[Hunter]] and [[Wrecker]] as they searched for [[bounty hunter]] [[Fennec Shand]].

==Biography==
A modified [[DUM-series pit droid]]<ref name="EPG" /> was manufactured by [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc.|Serv-O-Droid]].<ref name="Corr" /> The [[droid]] once functioned as a regular pit droid but began [[Bartender droid|working]] at [[Tanda's Cantina]] aboard the [[Suria space station]]<ref name="DB">{{Databank|tanda-s-cantina|Tanda's Cantina}}</ref> above the [[planet]] [[Suria]]<ref name="SSS">{{Databank|suria-space-station|Suria space station}}</ref> by at some point. The droid served at the bar at the [[cantina]] and broke up brawls amongst the patrons.<ref name="Declass">{{SW|url=news/bad-batch-declassified-bad-territory|text=''Bad Batch'' Declassified: 5 Highlights from "Bad Territory"|author=[[Kristin Baver|Baver, Kristin]]|date=2024-03-21}}</ref> 

Sometime during or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|308}}</ref> the droid was tending the bar at Tanda's, carrying a bottle from individual to individual. As the rogue [[Clone Force 99]] members [[Hunter]] and [[Wrecker]] entered the cantina in search of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Fennec Shand]], a [[Gotal]] dismissed the droid. The pit droid took notice of the newcomers and walked across the bar top, meeting them. After a brief conversation, the droid pointed towards Shand. As the droid departed, a nearby [[Arcona]] waved the server back. The droid obliged and poured a [[Color|blue]] [[Foodstuff|drink]] into the guest's cup. Nearby, an [[Aqualish]] and a [[Pantoran]] fought over a bottle, with the latter [[Blaster|shooting]] the former and claiming the bottle. As the winner raised the bottle in triumph, the droid chirped and took the bottle, using it to knock the troublemaker unconscious.<ref name="BT">{{TBB|Bad Territory}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
The modified droid had a black [[Photoreceptor|visual sensor]] and brown plating, with light gray plating around the both the rim of its dome and the [[sensor]].<ref name="EPG" /> The [[Maintenance droid|repair droid]]<ref name="Corr" /> wore a tall, tan [[hat]] with a pair of [[goggles]] around the brim.<ref name="EPG" /> They spoke through a series of chirps.<ref name="BT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The pit droid first appeared in "[[Bad Territory]],"<ref name="BT" /> the eighth episode of the [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', which premiered [[March 20]], [[2024]].<ref name="Episode">{{SW|url=news/the-bad-batch-season-3-trailer|text=Watch the ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 3 Trailer|date=2024-01-22}}</ref>
